# Archived Antigravity snapshots — DO NOT EDIT

Three earlier, incomplete copies of the same Next.js app, kept only for history.
Nothing here is built, served, or wired to the backend.

**The live application is:**

    Lite and Pro - Next.js Base/Pro — Notification Preview : Alert Review/

It is a strict superset: all four Pro screens, all four Lite screens, all eight routes.
Editing files in this folder has no effect on the running site.
